Abstract
Purpose
This paper reviews the existing literature on the divergence of
Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings and explores
various aggregation methods. It highlights the challenges posed by
inconsistent ESG ratings and their implications for investment
decisions.
Design/methodology/approach
The study conducts a comprehensive review of prior research
focusing on ESG ratings, examining their correlation levels and the
methodologies employed to assess corporate sustainability. It also
investigates traditional aggregation techniques and modern machine
learning approaches used to address these inconsistencies.
